title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates.
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition plays a crucial role in ensuring the health of both mother and baby. A balanced and varied diet will provide the necessary nutrients for the development of the fetus. In this article, we will explore international pantry staples that are good for pregnant women, helping to build balanced and delicious meals.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnant Women
The following international pantry staples are excellent choices for pregnant women:
- Oats: rich in fiber, helping to support digestive health and provide energy for the body.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, helping to support the development of bones and teeth in the fetus.
- Lentils: rich in protein, fiber, and essential vitamins, helping to support the development of the fetus.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, helping to support the development of the brain and vision in the fetus.
- Eggs: rich in protein, vitamins, and minerals, helping to support the development of the fetus.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamin C, helping to support the immune system and the development of the fetus.

## Combining International Pantry Staples into Meals
To combine these international pantry staples into meals, you can try the following:
- Add oats to breakfast, combined with Greek yogurt and fruit.
- Use lentils to make stews or soups, combined with leafy greens and spices.
- Grill low-mercury salmon and serve with leafy greens and brown rice.
- Add eggs to meals, combined with leafy greens and whole grains.
- Drink citrus juice or eat citrus fruits to supplement vitamin C.

## Food Safety Considerations
When pregnant, it's essential to consider food safety to avoid risks to the health of both mother and baby. Some important considerations include:
- Avoid eating raw or undercooked foods, especially meat, eggs, and seafood.
- Avoid eating foods high in mercury, such as shark and swordfish.
- Wash hands and cooking utensils frequently to avoid bacterial contamination.
- Read food labels and choose products from safe sources.

## Conclusion
International pantry staples can help build balanced and delicious meals for pregnant women. Remember to combine these staples into meals and consider food safety to ensure the health of both mother and baby.
